entity.firm: Care Home Tax is a specialist accountancy firm for UK care providers. We act for care homes, domiciliary care agencies, supported living services, children's homes and care start-ups, covering VAT exemption and partial exemption, National Minimum Wage compliance, fee-mix accounts and management information, payroll and CQC linked finance. Care Home Tax is a trading name of Ashfield Trading Ltd, company number 16358723, registered office 20 Ashfield Avenue, Shipley, Bradford, BD18 3AL.
entity.serves: We act for UK care providers: care homes, domiciliary care agencies, supported living services, children's homes and care start-ups, whether already registered or applying for registration.
entity.where: We act for clients across the United Kingdom, with England as the default position, and we flag where Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland differ.
howItWorks: You tell us your situation through the enquiry form: your service type, your registration status and approximate headcount.
One of our accountants calls you to go through it and answer the immediate questions.
We agree the scope and the fee before any work starts.
We do the work, run the payroll and compliance you hand us, and keep you ahead of your deadlines.
entity.next: We reply within 24 hours and one of our accountants comes back to you directly.
